hypothesis: W-R31 showed no downstream penalty after an adversarial legitimate marker intervention at full 8-bit precision. Under otherwise-unchanged CLEAN observed raw streams, lowering sensor precision to 4,2,1 bits can increase naturally occurring zero/all255/repeated-row aliases; this may cause the frozen W-R25 observed marker detector to suppress genuine transitions and harm the unchanged trained pair classifier.
freeze: Before first use freeze four high-bit quantizers expanded back to byte range; three existing generator families; two fixed swap positions; fresh heldout seeds; same fixed W-R22 trained model, metric definitions and classifications. No post-run repair of thresholds, cohort changes or repeat first use.

cohort.training_seeds: original W-R22 development 240..255, identical 1728 balanced examples

quantizer: For each untouched clean byte v, retain the top b bits via v>>(8-b), then remap the integer to floor(255*q/(2**b-1)); b in {8,4,2,1}. No missing samples are inserted. Quantization is applied symmetrically to positive and swapped negative candidates; base sequence is unchanged.
arms: all_observed (W-R19 all-channel top-two transition feature using the exact same trained weights)
outcome: At every heldout seed/generator/precision/site, count genuinely observed rows whose byte pattern triggers the multi-marker predicate; preserve individual TP/TN/FP/FN and 24 per-arm accuracy cells. QUANTIZED_MARKER_COST iff one-bit natural marker incidence exceeds 8-bit incidence by >=0.05 and multi_marker one-bit accuracy is at least 0.05 lower than all_observed on matched cells; ALIAS_WITHOUT_CONFIRMED_COST iff incidence condition holds but downstream cost does not; NO_ALIAS_GROWTH otherwise.
controls: No erased rows or synthetic marker insertion; all quantized values are genuinely observed
No change to learned weights, fit examples, model width, classification threshold or relative evaluation budget
Do not generalize these synthetic source generators to real-world sensor statistics or to semantic reasoning
Observe all negative and null per-seed outcomes; exact predecessor/prereg/code blob identities, original result artifact and one full Go regression/build
